question: Do all runners that can execute the release workflow support the Node 24 action runtime required by `actions/upload-artifact` v7?
rationale: Repository source and supplied CI results establish the narrow workflow change, but runner-fleet version and hosting are operational facts not provable from the PR diff alone.

options.title: Confirm runner support and merge
options.body: Verify that release jobs are GitHub-hosted or every eligible self-hosted runner meets the Node 24-era runner requirement, then merge this pinned dependency update.

options.title: Retain v4 temporarily
options.body: Keep the existing v4 pin only if an unsupported release runner cannot be upgraded before the next release window.

recommendation.title: Confirm runner support and merge
recommendation.body: Verify that release jobs are GitHub-hosted or every eligible self-hosted runner meets the Node 24-era runner requirement, then merge this pinned dependency update.

likelyOwner.reason: The release workflow owner is the appropriate person to verify the runner fleet or workflow hosting configuration.
